jobs.title: Full Time Security Officer (Mon-Fri, 7am-3pm)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The Security Officer for ParkX Management ensures that the facility is run smoothly, safely, cleanly, and is a good experience for residents, tenants, and guests.

Key Responsibilities

  • Complete hourly patrol route of the property using the security system
  • Access control for guests, tenants and vendors
  • Ensure no property is being damaged
  • Conduct of routine foot patrols in and around building.
  • Perform other duties as assigned 
  • Observation and reporting of safety
  • Issue Banning notices to rule violators      
  • Maintain file for Ban Notices and notify management when necessary
  • Maintain the appearance of the two plaza kiosks 
  • Enforce the “no dogs on the plaza” policy
  • Keep updated information (e.g., Kiss N Ride, Contact Phone #’s, Rules of Conduct) and communicate to guests as needed
  • Report any unknown work that is occurring at the property to management
  • If anyone parks illegally on the plaza, notify Park X, Commercial property management, and Residential property management immediately 
  • Communicate to guests that we must keep the fire access areas accessible for fire trucks and ambulances
  • Close loading dock doors as needed
  • Report any concerns to management
  • Reston and Loudoun Station: Assist the Marketing team before, during, and aft

jobs.title: Lead Concierge (M-F, 8am-4pm)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

Join our team as a concierge and become the epitome of hospitality excellence for our residents. As a trusted ambassador of our community, your primary focus will be delivering exceptional customer service and ensuring every resident’s needs are met with care and professionalism. From warmly greeting guests to providing personalized assistance, you’ll be the friendly, reliable presence our residents depend on. If you have a passion for creating memorable experiences and enjoy making people’s lives easier, this role is a perfect fit. Apply now and be a key part of our commitment to outstanding service. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Class “A” customer service – Building a good rapport with tenants and going above and beyond whenever possible
  • Meet and greet all visitors such as tenants, guests and prospects
  • Ensure reception area is tidy and presentable, with all necessary stationery and material (e.g. pens, forms and brochures)
  • Respond to tenant questions and complaints in a timely manner
  • Ensure that only authorized individuals enter the building
  • Manage incoming phone calls and direct them to the appropriate destination
  • Coordinate reservation for amenity space, loading elevators and loading dock
  • Complete daily building walks, looking for maintenance items, reorganizing furniture/décor and cleaning up whenever needed

jobs.title: Leasing Consultant ($1500 Sign-on Bonus)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

Comstock is excited to welcome a passionate Leasing Consultant to our team! As a leading developer of high-quality, sustainable, mixed-use, and transit-oriented communities, we’re looking for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, people-focused environment. This role is based at our luxury high-rise community, where skyline views, elevated living, and exceptional service set the tone. If you love connecting with people, creating memorable experiences, and guiding residents through the leasing journey from “hello” to “welcome home,” this opportunity was made for you. Join us and help bring our beautiful community to life. 

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide warm and engaging customer service, showcasing the benefits of our community.
  • Oversee the entire leasing process, from lead generation to tenant occupancy, ensuring a smooth experience for all.
  • Prepare leasing paperwork and maintain accurate weekly/monthly reports.
  • Creatively market the community online, through social media, and within the local neighborhood.
  • Coordinate promotions to increase traffic and maintain high occupancy rates.
  • Manage and innovate our social media presence to engage current and prospective tenants.
  • Perform administrative duties to support the leasing process and other assigned tasks.

Qualifications

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician (High Rise)
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

Join our dedicated maintenance team at a midrise apartment community, where exceptional service and high-quality living standards are top priorities. We are seeking a skilled Maintenance Technician with experience in HVAC, plumbing, electrical, appliance repair, and general carpentry. This role requires a proactive problem-solver who can perform preventative maintenance and respond to work orders efficiently and professionally. A strong commitment to customer service, clear communication, and a polished, resident-first attitude are essential in maintaining our five-star living environment. #weshowup

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide Class “A” customer service – building a good rapport with residents and going above and beyond whenever possible
  • Perform repairs, maintenance, and cleaning of property both interior and exterior
  • Protect and assist in improving the value of the client’s assets
  • Perform PM on unit based and building level equipment
  • Perform emergency on-call service in a rotation order 
  • Perform electrical, plumbing, carpentry, masonry and painting
  • Repair and treat structures such as showers, sinks, appliances, doors/cabinets, walls and building exteriors
  • Make ready units for new move-ins
  • Complete grounds work such as grounds pick up, sweeping and light landscaping
  • Perform other duties as assigned

jobs.title: Part-Time Office Porter - Team Lead
jobs.description_text:
Job Overview

The ParkX Office Porter is responsible for maintaining cleanliness in an office environment. This role ensures that all office areas, including floors, desks, restrooms, kitchens, and meeting rooms. are properly cleaned and maintained, providing a professional and comfortable environment for employees, clients, and visitors. The position requires reliability, attention to detail, and the ability to work professionally and courteously with property staff, tenants, and visitors.

Key Responsibilities

  • Clean and maintain all office areas, including floors, desks, restrooms, kitchens, and meeting rooms.
  • Empty trash and recycling bins regularly and dispose of waste appropriately.
  • Completes daily cleaning and janitorial tasks as assigned by the Senior Operations Manager, Janitorial.
  • Reports to assigned location in the approved ParkX Porter uniform.
  • Reports to assigned location before the start of the work shift.
  • Ensures compliance with all safety regulations and cleaning standards.
  • Exhibits a professional and courteous demeanor with all site visitors.
  • Acknowledges, greets, and interacts professionally with property staff and guests, using appropriate protocols.
  • Assists management teams with special cleaning or maintenance requests as needed.
  • Always maintains a neat and orderly janitorial closet and storage areas, free of debris

We’re energized by new challenges and new possibilities-and we’re just getting started!

About the role

As the Senior HR Business Partner, you will serve as the primary strategic advisor to our Sales and Marketing leaders. Operating in a high-growth SaaS environment, you will translate business priorities into people strategies that accelerate performance, scale organizational design, and build high-performing teams. This role requires agility - someone who can balance high-level strategic alignment with hands-on operational execution. The HR Team is on-site in Waltham 1-2 days / week. 

What You'll Do:

  • Business-Embedded HR Partnership: Build trusting relationships with leaders and proactively translate business priorities into people strategies, anticipate talent needs, navigate ambiguity with confidence, and guide executive decision-making.

Mission Value: Serve as the technical authority across a complex, multi-vendor AI and software platform, helping the government team make sound architecture decisions, resolve cross-platform integration challenges, and establish repeatable patterns that accelerate mission delivery.

Defense Unicorns is seeking a senior Technical Lead / Platform Solution Architect to embed with a government team and serve as the go-to technical subject matter expert across the platform architecture. The ideal candidate can move fluently between executive-level mission conversations and deep technical discussions with engineers and OEM teams.

jobs.location_raw: Chicago, IL · Austin, TX · New York, NY
jobs.description_text:
Who we are 

At Picnic, we’re reinventing the way employees experience lunch at work. By partnering with top local restaurants and batching hundreds of orders, we make it easy for companies to offer high-quality, individually packed meals, without fees or tips. Our mission is to create a seamless, affordable, and joyful lunch experience that benefits both employees and employers.

 

About the role

As a Territory Restaurant Manager, you’ll own restaurant supply for the XYZ region: find the right restaurants, sign the partner, and make sure they deliver: enough capacity, prepped on time, packaged properly, with menus and photos worth ordering from. That means real ownership and real accountability from day one. You’ll spend time in facilities and restaurants, tasting food and talking to operators.

 

What you’ll do

  • Selection. Selection depth and cuisine coverage are a key KPI. You decide where it comes from: brick-and-mortar partners, standalone restaurants, and CK facility operators (with CK sales). You make sure every hub has real options at the different price tiers.
  • Restaurant performance. Signing, onboarding, launch, and ongoing health. You own the capacity model, drive on-time prep, and make the pause and unpause calls. If a partner’s prep-by times slip in month three, that’s yours to diagnose and fix.
